metadata.title: Room 404: Midnight Boarding House
metadata.subtitle: The landlady warned: never reply if Room 404 texts after midnight. Tonight, she sent a voice note.

nodes.text: 12:04 AM · Your first night in Room 405 of the quiet 4th-floor boarding house. Heavy rain lashes the hallway window.
Welcome to your new room, {{player_name}}. One house rule: if 'Room 404' ever texts after midnight, DO NOT reply.
Wait... why? Doesn't a student live in Room 404 right next door?
Room 404 has been sealed since the girl vanished in 2022. Don't scare the new tenant.
Just an old prank number, dear. Lock your bolt and get some sleep.
2:17 AM · Three slow knocks rattle the thin wall between you and Room 404. Your phone screen glows ice-cold.

nodes.transcript: [Static & wet breathing] ...{{player_name}}... why did you take my room? Open the door... it's freezing in the hallway...

nodes.prompt: Something scratches against your doorknob! What do you do?

options.label: Text Room 403 neighbor for help
options.player_reply_text: Raka! Are you awake? Something is outside Room 405!

options.label: Check the hallway CCTV feed

nodes.text: {{player_name}}, stay away from the door! I can hear fingernails scraping down the hallway right now!
SECRET UNLOCKED: You open the building's guest CCTV link. The 4th-floor hallway is completely empty—yet a dark shadow is standing right behind your curtain!
The hallway is empty... the knocking is coming from INSIDE my room!
I can hear your heart beating, {{player_name}}. Don't trust the living here. Look behind your wall mirror.

nodes.headline: What Is Hidden Behind The Mirror?
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: The hallway lights die at 2:31 AM—and what you uncover behind the mirror changes everything.

nodes.text: 2:31 AM · The ceiling bulb pops and dies. Only your phone flashlight illuminates the cracked wall mirror.
{{player_name}}, are you okay?! The breaker just tripped across the entire 4th floor!
Room 404 told me to check behind my mirror. There's a loose wooden panel hidden here...
If {{player_name}} finds that girl’s phone behind the mirror, the police will reopen the 2022 Room 404 gas-leak fire case.
Oh God... the landlady knows what's behind this mirror! That girl didn't vanish!

nodes.transcript: [Clear, tearful whisper] Please, {{player_name}}... the cracked phone behind the mirror holds the video of who locked me in. Send it before 3 AM...

nodes.prompt: Heavy footsteps echo up the 4th-floor stairs! Act fast!

options.label: Grab the old phone & run to Room 403
options.player_reply_text: I have the phone! Open Room 403, Raka!

options.label: Watch the 2022 hidden video first

nodes.text: You yank the dusty phone from the wall cavity and sprint into the pitch-black corridor toward Room 403.
Hurry! My door is open—wait, why is the landlady coming up the stairs with a master key?!
SECRET UNLOCKED: The 2022 video plays—it's NOT the landlady dragging the girl into Room 404. It's a smiling guy holding a brass Room 403 keychain!
No way... the killer in the video is Raka from Room 403! And I just told him I found the phone!

nodes.transcript: [Slow key turning in your lock] Come on out, {{player_name}}. Why did you have to look behind the mirror? We could've been such good neighbors...

nodes.headline: The Real Killer Lives Next Door...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 3: The elevator panel lights up for Floor 4—even though the fourth floor is sealed shut.

nodes.text: 2:42 AM · Boarding house corridor. A cold draft seeps under your door as your phone chimes.
{{player_name}}, lock your chain! Raka was never a student—he lived in 403 the night of the 2022 Room 404 gas-leak fire!

nodes.caption: Elevator Panel (2:41 AM): Button "4" is glowing red—pressed from inside an empty shaft.

nodes.text: Wait... Room 404 is texting photos from the elevator?! Who is still up here with me?!
Marni paid the police to list Room 404 as an accident so she wouldn't lose her building permit.
Don't listen to Landlady Marni, {{player_name}}! Check the cracked mirror—she hid the dead girl's ledger behind it!

nodes.transcript: [hollow whisper, dripping water] "Room 403 has the spare key... He watched me through the wall..."

nodes.text: Why did my master key disappear from my desk?! Raka, step away from {{player_name}}'s door!

nodes.prompt: Heavy footsteps stop right between 403 and 404. What do you do?

options.label: Check the hidden ledger behind the mirror
options.player_reply_text: I'm reading the ledger right now—I want to know who died in 404.

options.label: Record the hallway through the door crack
options.player_reply_text: Camera rolling—I'm catching whoever is holding that master key on video.

nodes.text: Read page 9... Her name was Sari. She found a peephole drilled from Room 403.
VIP TWIST: Your video catches Raka wiping blood-red paint off a brass master key—the exact key to 404!
You're awake, {{player_name}}? Your hallway light just turned off...
OH GOD! He cut the corridor breaker! Stay inside!

nodes.headline: Footsteps In Room 403...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: A shadow slides a key under your door—and the wall between 403 and 404 opens.

nodes.text: 3:15 AM · Pitch black on Floor 4. Only your phone screen illuminates the narrow boarding room.
Open the door, {{player_name}}. Landlady Marni is coming up with a crowbar—I'm trying to save you!

nodes.caption: Floor 4 Corridor (3:14 AM): A silhouette stands motionless outside your door holding a brass key.

nodes.text: Both of you are blaming each other—and someone is literally unlocking my deadbolt!
I only wedged 404 during the gas leak because Sari owed me money—I didn’t mean for the fire to kill her!
HE WEDGED MY DOOR SHUT DURING THE 2022 GAS-LEAK FIRE. HE HEARD ME BEGGING FOR AN HOUR.

nodes.transcript: [panting on stairs] I called the police! They're five minutes out—push your desk against the wardrobe wall, there's a hidden hatch from 403!

nodes.text: Too late, {{player_name}}. The wardrobe panel is already open.

nodes.prompt: The wardrobe door creaks inward! What is your split-second move?

options.label: Shove the heavy desk against the wardrobe
options.player_reply_text: Not today! The desk is wedged tight—police are almost here!

options.label: Flash Sari's silver locket at the shadow
options.player_reply_text: Look what I found behind the mirror, Raka—Sari's locket with your fingerprint!

nodes.text: Let me out! The door to 403 just slammed shut by itself!
VIP TWIST: The locket chills the room—the lights flicker violently and Room 404's door bursts open behind him!
The police are at the gate. Don't let him escape down the fire stairs.
I have the hallway camera tape! Meet me by the stairwell!

nodes.headline: The Midnight Tape...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Hallway CCTV footage from the night Sari died finally plays—exposing the full truth.

nodes.text: 4:04 AM · The stairwell landing. Landlady Marni hands you a dusty SD card as sirens wail outside.
I was too terrified to turn this in last year. Watch what Raka did at 14:04 AM.

nodes.caption: Archived Cam 4F (2022): Raka jamming a wedge under Room 404’s door during the gas leak before slipping back into 403.

nodes.text: He jammed her door shut from the outside?! That wasn't an accident—it was murder!
I stayed quiet because he threatened to burn the entire boarding house down.
Give me that SD card, {{player_name}}! Nobody will believe a ghost story!

nodes.transcript: [clear, echoing voice] "The elevator is open, Raka. Step inside and tell the officers why you jammed my door."

nodes.text: Who is playing that audio?! STOP IT! My phone won't turn off!

nodes.prompt: Raka lunges for the SD card on the stairs. What do you do?

options.label: Toss the SD card down to the police officer
options.player_reply_text: Officer, catch! Everything from the night Room 404 died is on this card!

options.label: AirDrop the footage to every tenant first
options.player_reply_text: Too late to destroy it—every tenant and officer on the stairs just got the video!

nodes.text: The officer caught it! Raka, it's over!
VIP TWIST: Ten phones chime in unison across the stairwell—Raka drops to his knees in total defeat!
I didn't mean to kill her! Tell Room 404 to stop texting me!
Wait until sunrise, {{player_name}}. One last thing before I go.

nodes.headline: Dawn Over Floor Four
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Season Finale): First light breaks over the boarding house—and Room 404 sends one final message.

nodes.text: 5:45 AM · Golden sunlight hits the fourth-floor hallway. Police lead Raka away in handcuffs.
The detectives sealed Room 403 as a crime scene. I'm sorry I didn't speak up sooner, {{player_name}}.
Sari finally gets justice. That's all she ever wanted when she texted after midnight.
Thank you for answering me when everyone else locked their doors.
I'm refunding your entire year's rent and renovating Floor 4 into a memorial garden.
My mother lives two towns over. Please give her the silver locket.

nodes.transcript: [soft morning breeze, gentle chime] "Goodbye, {{player_name}}. You can sleep peacefully tonight."

nodes.text: Look at the Room 404 chat... The contact just vanished from your phone.

nodes.prompt: Morning sun warms the empty corridor. Choose your Season Finale!

options.label: Place white flowers by Room 404 and move on
options.player_reply_text: Rest in peace, Sari. Your truth is finally free.

options.label: Deliver the locket to Sari's mother today
options.player_reply_text: I'm taking the first train to bring Sari's locket—and justice—home to her mom.

nodes.text: The hallway feels warm again for the first time in three years.
VIP FINALE: Sari's mother weeps with gratitude as she holds the locket—and your phone never buzzes at midnight again.
Safe travels, {{player_name}}. You broke the curse of Floor Four.
Room 404 is finally quiet. Good morning.

nodes.headline: A Second Locket Under Room 404...
nodes.teaser_text: Act 2 · Episode 7: Just as the chat vanishes at dawn, Room 404 flickers back—Raka did not act alone in 2022.

nodes.text: 10:15 AM · Sunlight warms Floor 4 as you pack. Suddenly, the deleted Room 404 thread reappears at the top of your screen.
Don't leave yet, {{player_name}}. Lift the loose floorboard under Room 404's window—there is a second locket from 2018.

nodes.caption: 2018 Municipal Fire Report · Room 404 Tenant Missing After "Accidental Gas Leak" — Case Closed Without Autopsy.

nodes.text: Wait... another girl died in Room 404 FOUR years before Sari?! And the same gas line failed twice?!
{{player_name}}, dear, please step out of Room 404. The floorboards are rotting—let the police handle old paperwork.

nodes.prompt: Landlady Marni is watching from the stairwell doorway. What do you do?

options.label: Hide the 2018 report in your backpack
options.player_reply_text: Just grabbing my umbrella, Landlady Marni.

options.label: Check the beneficiary name on page two

nodes.text: Good. Lock up and rest—you've already been through enough, {{player_name}}.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Page two lists a forged tenant life-insurance policy—and the sole beneficiary is LANDLADY MARNI!
Hold on... why was Marni so eager to seal Floor 4 and send me away with a full rent refund?
Raka jammed my door in panic, {{player_name}}... but he never turned the basement gas valve.

nodes.headline: Who Opened The Gas Valve?
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 8: Rain returns at dusk—and Room 404 calls your phone with a terrifying revelation.

nodes.text: 4:40 PM · Storm clouds darken the boarding house windows. Your screen flashes red with an impossible incoming call.
I'm heading to the market, {{player_name}}. Don't touch the basement door—the pipes are still leaking.
Through crackling static, Sari whispers urgently: "The gas didn't leak by accident. Marni twisted the red basement valve at 2:00 AM!"
You decline. A chilling voicemail auto-transcribes instantly: "Marni opened the basement gas valve in 2018 AND 2022."
No way... Marni cried in the stairwell and handed me the SD card! Why would she frame Raka if she was guilty too?!

nodes.prompt: You hear a padlock rattle down by the basement stairs. Act fast!

options.label: Text Marni & test her alibi right now
options.player_reply_text: Landlady Marni, who lived in Room 404 back in 2018?

options.label: Snap a photo of the freshly oiled gas valve

nodes.text: 2018? Nobody, dear—the room was empty for storage. Why are you asking?
SECRET UNLOCKED: Peeking through the basement grate, you spot fresh wrench marks on the Room 404 gas riser—and a tin cash box!
She's lying to your face, {{player_name}}. Ask Raka what he saw on the basement stairs that night.
I never thought I'd say this... I need to hear Raka's side of the story.

nodes.headline: The Ally Turns Suspect...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 9: A message arrives from Raka's legal counsel—and blows Landlady Marni's cover wide open.

nodes.text: 7:20 PM · Rain drums against Room 405. Your phone chimes with a verified message relayed from Raka's lawyer.
{{player_name}}, I deserve jail for wedging 404's door when Sari threatened to report my debt. But I SWEAR I never touched the gas!
Then why did Room 404 fill with gas while you were standing in the hallway, Raka?!
Because Marni was already in the basement! She offered to erase my rent debt if I kept quiet about the 2018 fire!

nodes.transcript: [detention center phone] Listen to me! Marni forged tenant signatures on life-insurance riders—she collected payouts on BOTH Room 404 girls!

nodes.prompt: Can you trust the man who trapped Sari in 2022?

options.label: Demand bank proof of Marni's payout
options.player_reply_text: If Marni took insurance money, show me where the proof is.

options.label: Ask why Marni kept the 2022 CCTV SD card
options.player_reply_text: Why did she hand me the SD card if she was guilty?

nodes.text: I photographed her bank slip on her desk last year before she hid it—forwarding it to your phone now.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Raka reveals Marni gave you the edited SD card to pin the entire death on him—so the police would never audit the basement!
She used ME to get Raka arrested and close the case forever...
{{player_name}}? Are you still awake up there? I brought you warm ginger tea.

nodes.headline: Don't Drink The Tea...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 10: Marni's footsteps stop outside Room 405—just as Raka's bank transfer photo lands on your screen.

nodes.text: 9:15 PM · Through the peephole, Landlady Marni smiles warmly holding a steaming ceramic mug. Your phone vibrates.
Make sure the developer's deposit clears tonight before I burn the 2018 ledger.

nodes.caption: Wire Confirmation · $185,000 Life Insurance Payout — Credited to Marni Subagio, 14 days after Sari's death.

nodes.text: A hundred and eighty-five thousand dollars?! And she just unsent a text about burning the 2018 ledger!
Don't open the door, {{player_name}}. She put sleeping pills in that tea—just like she did to me.

nodes.prompt: Marni knocks gently on Room 405. How do you play this?

options.label: Pretend to be asleep & stay dead silent
Confront her through the door about the wire
options.player_reply_text: Keep the tea, Marni. I just saw the $185,000 insurance transfer.

nodes.text: Oh, already asleep? Sleep tight, dear. Tonight is going to be very quiet.
SECRET UNLOCKED: The ceramic mug shatters on the hallway tiles—Marni's sweet mask snaps into pure fury!
I need to get out of this boarding house right now and take this bank slip straight to the police!
CLANK. Downstairs, the heavy iron front gate slams shut—followed by the sharp grind of a steel chain.

nodes.headline: The Iron Gate Locks From Outside...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 11: Midnight strikes on Floor 4—and the smell of kerosene drifts up the stairwell.

nodes.text: 12:08 AM · Midnight returns to the boarding house. A sharp smell of kerosene creeps beneath your doorframe.
The front gate is chained shut! And the hallway lights just flickered off!

nodes.transcript: [urgent whisper over static] {{player_name}}! She's pouring kerosene by the stairwell to stage an electrical fire! Don't run downstairs!

nodes.text: You should have taken the rent refund and left this morning, {{player_name}}. Curious tenants never last on Floor 4.
Hey—there's an old servant staircase hidden behind the wardrobe in Room 404! It leads straight to the boiler room!

nodes.prompt: Orange sparks hiss at the end of the hall! Choose fast!

options.label: Slip into Room 404 & check the wardrobe
options.player_reply_text: I'm heading into Room 404 right now!

options.label: Trigger the hallway fire hose reel first

nodes.text: I'm inside Room 404—the air is freezing, and the wardrobe back panel is already unlatched!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Blasting the fire hose floods the stairwell landing, dousing Marni's kerosene trail and trapping her on Floor 3!
Look at the hallway camera feed I just sent you, {{player_name}}. She isn't alone on Floor 3.
Come out, {{player_name}}! I have the master key to every room up here!

nodes.headline: Smoke Under Room 404...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 12: The hallway camera loads—showing who else Marni paid to burn the building down.

nodes.text: 1:14 AM · Crouched inside Room 404, you stare at the dim CCTV feed glowing on your phone.
Wait... why is the hallway completely empty if I can hear footsteps right outside?!

nodes.caption: Floor 4 CCTV (1:14 AM) · Corridor empty except for pale smoke curling beneath the sealed threshold.

nodes.text: She looped the hallway camera—just like she did the night I died. She's standing right outside 405.
Empty room... clever. You went into 404, didn't you, {{player_name}}?

nodes.prompt: A brass master key slides into Room 404's deadbolt!

options.label: Duck behind the wardrobe service hatch
options.player_reply_text: Closing the hidden panel behind me—stay quiet!

options.label: Jam a wooden chair back under the doorknob

nodes.text: The hatch latches shut just as Room 404's door swings wide open.
SECRET UNLOCKED: The jammed doorknob snaps her brass master key clean inside the lock—locking Marni out in the smoky corridor!
You little rat! You think hiding in a dead girl's room will save you?!
My phone is ringing... Marni is calling me from the other side of the wall.

nodes.headline: The Landlady's True Face
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 13: Landlady Marni drops the sweet act completely—and confesses everything on a live line.

nodes.text: 1:32 AM · Inside the narrow service landing behind Room 404, dust hangs thick in your flashlight beam.
Keep recording... if she confesses on this call, she's finished.
Marni's voice drips with venom: "This building sits on a million-dollar lot! Two 'accidents' cleared the tenants—and tonight finishes the deal!"
You decline. A furious voicemail lands: "I paid off the fire inspector in 2018 and 2022—you won't stop my redevelopment deal!"
Hand over the 2018 deed and I'll unlock the front gate right now, {{player_name}}.

nodes.prompt: You just caught her full confession on audio! Next move?

options.label: Save the audio & descend the service stairs
options.player_reply_text: I'm heading down to the basement boiler room for the ledger.

options.label: Upload the confession to cloud storage now

nodes.text: Follow the cold draft down the wooden steps, {{player_name}}. Her tin box is behind the boiler.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Your cloud backup syncs right before the basement kills your bars—and auto-shares a copy to the police tip line!
I can see the basement boiler glowing orange at the bottom of the stairs.
Hurry, {{player_name}}—she realized the service hatch is open. She's taking the main stairs down to trap you.

nodes.headline: Race To The Boiler Room
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 14: Down the hidden stairwell lies the tin box holding Sari's real diary and every forged policy.

nodes.text: 1:48 AM · Narrow wooden steps creak beneath your sneakers. Water drips steadily down the concrete walls of the basement.
Stay low, {{player_name}}. Behind the rusty water heater is a brick niche—that's where she hid my diary.
Found the niche! There's a rusted tin box taped shut with red wax.

nodes.transcript: [soft, trembling voice] Inside are the forged life-insurance policies for me, the 2018 tenant, and... a blank one with YOUR name on it.

nodes.text: Got you, {{player_name}}. Enjoy the basement.

nodes.prompt: The heavy steel basement door slams toward the frame!

options.label: Grab the tin box & dash for the door
options.player_reply_text: I have the tin box—don't lock me down here!

options.label: Throw a rusted pipe wrench into the door gap

nodes.text: The steel bolt clangs shut a split second before I reach it—I'm locked inside the boiler room!
SECRET UNLOCKED: The wrench bends the latch just enough to leave a half-inch breathing gap—keeping the room from sealing airtight!
{{player_name}}, listen! If she cuts the basement lights, she's going for the main gas manifold next!
The single bare bulb overhead pops—and a loud metallic hiss echoes through the dark pipes.

nodes.headline: Act 3: The Basement Trap
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 15: 2:05 AM — Trapped in the dark boiler room with the exact gas leak that killed Room 404.

nodes.text: 2:05 AM · Pitch black in the flooded boiler room. Your phone screen illuminates three forged insurance policies inside the tin box.
She already drafted a policy with MY name on it! I was supposed to be the third "accident" on Floor 4!
Not tonight, {{player_name}}. I won't let her take another soul in this house.
Tell the developer the building will be empty by 3 AM—the gas leak is already running.
A sharp, rotten-egg smell fills the basement air. Your throat tightens.

nodes.prompt: Gas is pouring from the main riser! What do you do first?

options.label: Tie your wet scarf over your mouth & nose
options.player_reply_text: Covering my face—where is the emergency shutoff?!

options.label: Photograph every forged policy in the box

nodes.text: Five minutes and you'll be asleep forever, {{player_name}}. Just like Sari.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Your flash captures every forged signature and Marni's thumbprint—and the tin box hides a brass spare key to the alley grate!
I can barely breathe down here... Raka, tell me how to shut off this gas line!
Hold your phone steady, {{player_name}}. I'm keeping your signal alive from Floor 4.

nodes.headline: Five Minutes Of Air Left...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 16: Racing the rising gas in pitch darkness to find the hidden emergency shutoff valve.

nodes.text: 2:20 AM · Dizzy from the fumes, you sweep your phone flashlight across a maze of rusted iron pipes.
There are four red valves on this wall! If I turn the wrong one, it'll flood the room faster!
Don't touch the top row! The shutoff for the whole house is the corroded brass wheel near the floor drain!

nodes.transcript: [shouting clearly] Turn it CLOCKWISE three full turns! Use your jacket sleeve so the rust doesn't slice your hands!

nodes.text: I'm right beside you, {{player_name}}. Push—turn it with everything you have!

nodes.prompt: The brass wheel is rusted stiff! Your vision blurs!

options.label: Brace both boots on the wall & heave clockwise
options.player_reply_text: It's moving—one, two, THREE turns! The hiss stopped!

options.label: Hook the iron pipe as a lever to snap it shut

nodes.text: The hissing dies instantly! Fresh cold air drifts in from the alley vent!
SECRET UNLOCKED: The pipe snaps the main valve shut in two seconds—and rattles the entire building's radiator pipes like an alarm bell!
Wait... why did the gas meter stop spinning?! Who is helping you down there?!
The basement door bolt slides back... Marni is standing at the top of the stairs with a lighter.

nodes.headline: Shadow At The Top Of The Stairs
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 17: Marni clicks her lighter—just as Room 404 makes one final call to wake the entire building.

nodes.text: 2:35 AM · Heavy footsteps pause at the top of the basement stairs. A tiny yellow flame flickers in the dark.

nodes.caption: Basement Stairwell (2:35 AM) · Landlady Marni silhouetted at the doorway holding a brass lighter.

nodes.text: Sari's voice booms through EVERY hallway speaker on all four floors: "WAKE UP! MARNI IS BURNING THE BUILDING! CHECK THE BASEMENT!"
Even declined, the call hijacks the boarding house intercom—Sari's echoing scream jolts every tenant awake on Floors 1 through 4!
TURN THAT OFF!! How is a dead girl talking through my intercom?!

nodes.prompt: Tenants are shouting upstairs! Marni raises the lighter in panic!

options.label: Hurl the rusty water bucket up the stairs
options.player_reply_text: Drop the lighter, Marni—the whole building is awake!

options.label: Blast your flashlight strobe into her eyes

nodes.text: Water splashes across the top step—extinguishing her lighter on the spot!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Blinded by the strobe, Marni stumbles back and drops her master keyring right down the stairs into your hands!
The tenants on Floor 1 just heard sirens, {{player_name}}. Go—end this nightmare!
Heavy shoulders slam against the basement door from the hallway side as neighbors rush to pull you out!

nodes.headline: The Fourth Floor Awakens
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 18: Tenants break open the basement door—and Marni bolts for the rain-soaked back alley.

nodes.text: 2:46 AM · Three neighbors haul the basement door open and pull you out into the cool hallway air.
Don't let Marni escape! She's running for the back alley with her cash box!
Get out of my way! This boarding house belongs to ME!

nodes.transcript: [breathless, running] Police are already at the main lane! Everyone block the front gate—I have the 2018 and 2022 insurance box!

nodes.text: She's trapped between the alley wall and the patrol lights, {{player_name}}. Don't let go of my diary.

nodes.prompt: Marni lunges at you in the rain-slicked courtyard for the tin box!

options.label: Sidestep & toss the tin box to the lead officer
options.player_reply_text: Officer, catch! Every forged policy is inside!

options.label: Play Marni's live call confession on max speaker

nodes.text: NO!! Give me that box—those papers are private!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Marni's own voice confessing to the 2018 and 2022 gas leaks blasts across the courtyard in front of six officers!
It's over, Marni. Both Room 404 cases are wide open now.
Red and blue lights wash over the courtyard as officers step between you and the trembling landlady.

nodes.headline: The Last Midnight
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 19: Handcuffs snap shut at the iron gate—and the truth of Floor Four is finally sealed on record.

nodes.text: 3:08 AM · Rain patters gently on patrol car roofs. Detectives photograph the tin box, the 2018 fire report, and the oiled gas valve.
You ungrateful tenant... I gave you a roof over your head!
You tried to turn Room 404 into a death trap three times for insurance money. Tell it to the judge.
The detectives just notified my lawyer—they're charging Marni with double homicide and arson. Thank you for actually listening, {{player_name}}.
Officers guide Marni into the back of the cruiser. For the first time in years, the oppressive chill lifts from the fourth floor.

nodes.prompt: The lead detective asks if you want to hand over Sari's diary as Exhibit A.

options.label: Submit copies & keep the original for Sari's mom
options.player_reply_text: Here are full scans—her mother deserves the real diary.

options.label: Ask detectives to unseal Room 404 at sunrise

nodes.text: This isn't over... my lawyers will have me out by noon!
SECRET UNLOCKED: The detective nods solemnly—"With your audio confession and the bank wire, she's never seeing bail."
Wait for sunrise one last time, {{player_name}}. Both of us can finally rest.
The patrol cruisers roll away down the wet lane, leaving the boarding house wrapped in soft pre-dawn quiet.

nodes.headline: Sunrise Over Floor Four...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 20 (Grand Finale): Morning breaks clear and warm—and Room 404 sends one final, peaceful goodbye.

nodes.text: 7:00 AM · Pale golden sunlight pours down the fourth-floor corridor. The rain has cleared completely.
Both lockets—2018 and 2022—are safe with their families. And Marni's redevelopment deal was voided by the city.
The hallway isn't cold anymore, {{player_name}}. Thank you for staying until the whole truth came out.

nodes.transcript: [warm morning birdsong, gentle chime] "Goodbye, {{player_name}}. Neither of us is trapped in Room 404 anymore."

nodes.text: Before your eyes, the Room 404 chat fades to "Archived Forever." A gentle breeze rustles the white curtains.

nodes.prompt: The moving cab honks gently outside the sunlit gate. Choose your Grand Finale!

options.label: Leave two white lilies by Room 404 & depart
options.player_reply_text: Rest easy, both of you. Good morning.

options.label: Attend the memorial with Sari's mother today

nodes.text: You place two fresh white lilies beside the open doorway of Room 404 and walk down into the bright morning.
VIP FINALE: Sari's mother and the 2018 tenant's sister embrace you tearfully at the memorial—"You gave our daughters their names back."
Floor Four is finally at peace. Time to start a brand-new chapter.
You step out past the open iron gate into the sunlit street. Midnight will never knock on your door again.

nodes.headline: Room 404 Is Finally Free.
nodes.teaser_text: Grand Finale Complete · You exposed Landlady Marni's conspiracy, survived the basement gas trap, and freed every soul on Floor Four.
